canvas.help: Drag the board to move it, the wheel to zoom. Drag from a port onto a node to connect. Tab to a node, Enter to open it, arrows to move it, Delete to remove it, F2 to rename it, D to switch it off, P to pin it, right-click for more. N adds a node, Shift+S a note, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste, Ctrl+Z undoes, 1 fits the view, Shift+Alt+T tidies up.
canvas.helpReadOnly: Drag the board to move it, the wheel or two fingers to zoom. Tab to a node and press Enter to see it.

nodeHints.manual: Start it yourself, from here or a list.
nodeHints.schedule: Start it at set times or intervals.
nodeHints.webhook: Start it when an address is called.
nodeHints.if: Go one way or the other on a condition.
nodeHints.wait: Pause for a while or until a time.
nodeHints.http: Call a web address and keep the answer.
nodeHints.chat: Post a message to a chat service.
nodeHints.called: Starts when another automation runs this one.
nodeHints.onEvent: Starts when an automation announces this name.
nodeHints.failed: Starts when one of the chosen automations fails.
nodeHints.switch: Take the path of the first matching case.
nodeHints.parallel: Run several paths side by side.
nodeHints.join: Wait for paths to meet before going on.
nodeHints.forEach: Run the steps inside once for every item.
nodeHints.repeat: Run the steps inside several times.
nodeHints.stop: End the run here, as done or failed.
nodeHints.waitEvent: Pause until a name is announced, or time runs out.
nodeHints.run: Start another automation with values you give it.
nodeHints.answer: Send values back to the automation that called.
nodeHints.announce: Tell other automations that something happened.
nodeHints.try: Run the steps inside, and choose what follows a failure.
nodeHints.waitCondition: Pause until a condition is true, or time runs out.

flow.itemHint: Steps inside read the item as {item} and its position as {index}.

flow.whenCombined: These start a run together, within the window.

flow.recoverOff: The run still ends as failed once the On error and Always steps finish.
flow.tryErrorHint: On error and Always read what failed as {example}.
flow.conditionWaitHint: Checked on every announcement here and on the clock. Read an announcement as {example}.
flow.recheckRange: Check again between every minute and once a day.
flow.builtInEvent: Polaris also announces {name} whenever an automation here ends.
flow.eventNameReserved: Names starting with {prefix} are kept for Polaris.
flow.outcomesAny: None ticked takes any ending. Read it as {example}.
